## Description

Embeds option implied volatility surface features into parameterized quantum circuits (Quantum Neural Networks) to forecast volatility smile shifts and skew distortions.

## Where it may fit

Options market making, volatility surface arbitrage, earnings announcement volatility forecasting.

## Vehicles

## Required data

Intraday option chain quotes, implied volatility surface matrices, underlying spot quotes.

## Caveats
